observes: Seeded defects in the 2 AUDITE trace(s) of module 08 (a dropped model-relevant record, two steps' or two transactions' records or two writes of one node swapped, a copy of a record attributed to process 999999), each replayed through the as-built machines: readonly: dropped-record by faithfulness; reordered-transaction by none of its expected rules (fired: faithfulness,foreign-process); foreign-write by foreign-process | txn: dropped-record by continuity; reordered-transaction by model-post-state; foreign-write by foreign-process. In 08/readonly the swapped steps are two identical machine actions (AqlWrite), so no model rule can see their order; the reorder was flagged by faithfulness and foreign-process only, which run.py does not count as caught
